svg.title: vibe-dlmath — follow the classic proof routes
svg.desc: A spiral galaxy drawn as an optimisation picture: concentric level sets of a quadratic loss, two heavy-ball trajectories that spiral as logarithmic spirals into the minimiser theta-star, and faint formulas from optimisation, generalisation, concentration and transport in the surrounding starfield. Beside it: vibe-dlmath, with the tagline: follow the classic proof routes, every step in the open.
